tagline: Local GGUF models, chat, and OpenAI-compatible API
description:
Download a GGUF model, run llama-server, and chat in the browser — or call
OpenAI-compatible `/v1` APIs from OpenCode, curl, and other clients.

NVIDIA: ZimaOS GPU reservation (same as Ollama Nvidia GPU) plus
`nvidia-smi` inside the container. CUDA 12 with Maxwell `50-virtual`
(Quadro K2200). Vulkan for AMD.

Create an API key in the app settings, then point clients at
`http://YOUR_HOST_IP:8788/v1`.
author: Carpathians

tips.before_install:
Requires a ZimaOS host with NVIDIA drivers (same as Ollama Nvidia GPU).

After install, open port **8788** for the UI and `/v1` API.

title: LLM Proxy
release_note:
0.9.30 — plan GPU layers and min context; fix webfetch

Explicit -ngl from VRAM (no llama.cpp --fit). Min context
offloads layers. Webfetch accepts any HTTP 200.
